$comment: The pinned natural surveys the lints (tools/lint.mjs; kit/lib/lint/vworld-fixtures.mjs) build their virtual worlds from: never a live seed (gate7ak1.mjs: the live seed drifts). Each is a plan directory (ir.json, survey.bin, meta.json, blobs/) committed in the repo; surveySha pins the survey bytes (a re-pin is an edit here, with the run it came from). minecraft: the version the survey was read on; a Minecraft update re-reads each (docs/GATES.md "Fast checks (P2)").
